title: Binyamin (All the Sages Whose Father Was Named Binyamin)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Abba bar Binyamin: Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit, chapter 6, end of halakhah 3.
Giddel bar Binyamin: Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, chapter 8, halakhah 8.
Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Binyamin: Shir HaShirim Rabbah, end of chapter 4.[^1]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer text has Abba bar Binyamin at Sheviit 6:3 and Giddul bar Binyamin at Pesachim 8:8. Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:16 fully names Rabbi Yehoshua beRabbi Binyamin bar Levi. Hyman’s shorter names and end-of-chapter citation are retained; the collective heading is not a claim that these notices concern one person.
